$comment: Harness read manifest: data only, not code. A harness reads this file and blocks agent file-read tools (read, glob, grep on files) for denied paths. This manifest does NOT govern MCP tools. get_ref is the only sanctioned body fetch, stays allowed, and must not be blocked by this manifest.
note: Manifest is for agent read tools, not for MCP tools. Do not block get_ref.

deny_rules.reason: Raw skill bodies must not be read directly. Use get_ref to fetch a routed skill body or section.
Same as above: no direct read of skills/**/SKILL.md. Use get_ref.

allow_rules.reason: Card metadata is safe to read. Cards hold routing facts, not raw bodies.
Docs under subfolders are safe to read.

sanctioned_fetch.reason: get_ref is the only sanctioned body fetch. It is an MCP tool, not an agent read tool, so this manifest never blocks it.
